title: Albums
text:
Select an album from the dropdown below to view its cover:

albums = [
  { name: "Queen (1973)", file: "data/1973_queen.jpg" },
  { name: "Queen II (1974)", file: "data/1974_queen_ii.jpg" },
  { name: "Sheer Heart Attack (1974)", file: "data/1974_sheer_heart_attack.jpg" },
  { name: "A Night at the Opera (1975)", file: "data/1975_a_night_at_the_opera.jpg" },
  { name: "A Day at the Races (1976)", file: "data/1976_a_day_at_the_races.jpg" },
  { name: "News of the World (1977)", file: "data/1977_news_of_the_world.jpg" },
  { name: "Jazz (1978)", file: "data/1978_jazz.jpg" },
  { name: "The Game (1980)", file: "data/1980_the_game.jpg" },
  { name: "Flash Gordon (1980)", file: "data/1980_flash_gordon.jpg" },
  { name: "Hot Space (1982)", file: "data/1982_hot_space.jpg" },
  { name: "The Works (1984)", file: "data/1984_the_works.jpg" },
  { name: "A Kind of Magic (1986)", file: "data/1986_a_kind_of_magic.jpg" },
  { name: "The Miracle (1989)", file: "data/1989_the_miracle.jpg" },
  { name: "Innuendo (1991)", file: "data/1991_innuendo.jpg" },
  { name: "Made in Heaven (1995)", file: "data/1995_made_in_heaven.jpg" }
]

viewof selected = Inputs.select(
  albums,
  { label: "Select an album:", format: d => d.name }
)
















html`<img src="${selected.file}" alt="${selected.name}" style="max-width: 500px; width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; margin-top: 1rem;">`
